method: S1 representation-inversion decoders (linear + MLP) on KV

embedding_cosine_knownpairs.note: orthogonal KV mask is linearly invertible given masked pairs -> similar cosine

limitations: Layer-0 KV (least contextualized) is the attacker-favourable case; deeper layers mix context and are harder to invert to a single token.

Closed-set token classification over tokens present gives a clean chance baseline but is easier than open-vocabulary recovery; the plaintext-vs-masked-transfer CONTRAST is the design-relevant quantity.
The masked-adapted decoder assumes masked (KV_tilde, token) pairs; consistent with S1, the orthogonal KV mask provides no information-theoretic protection — confidentiality is the secret mask / TEE.
KV masks are orthogonal per-kv-head (Bk rope-commuting, Sv signed-perm); norms/Grams are preserved as in S1 (documented structural leak).

interpretation.masked_transfer_reduced: a plaintext-calibrated decoder applied to masked KV drops to top1=0.003 (attacker does not know the mask) => masking REDUCES recovery for an attacker without the secret mask.
interpretation.masked_adapted_caveat: with masked pairs the orthogonal mask is invertible: an adapted decoder recovers top1=0.536 => protection rests on mask secrecy (the TEE), not on information destruction.
